units.source_text: 写毕，不好意思立刻离去。

en.t: After finishing the letter, he felt too embarrassed to leave at once.

units.source_text: 紫姬说：“这叫我多难堪啊！”

en.t: Lady Murasaki said, "How terribly awkward this makes things for me!"

units.source_text: 源氏便穿上轻柔的衫子，飘着芬芳的衣香，匆匆出门而去。

en.t: Genji then put on a soft robe and hurried out, trailing the delicate fragrance of his garments.

units.source_text: 紫姬目送他走，心中很不自在。

en.t: Lady Murasaki watched him leave, feeling deeply uneasy.

units.source_text: 她想：“近几年来，我也曾担心以后是否还会发生事情。

en.t: She thought, "In recent years I too have worried whether something might happen again someday.

units.source_text: 但念如今已非少年，此念应已离绝。

en.t: But I told myself that he was no longer young, and that such thoughts must surely have been put away.

units.source_text: 诚能如此，则今后便可放心。

en.t: If that were truly so, then I could feel at ease from now on.

units.source_text: 平安无事直到今日，岂知又发生了这件难于告人之事。

en.t: Everything had remained peaceful until today, yet who could have known that this shameful matter, so hard to speak of, would occur again?

units.source_text: 世事如此变化无定，今后很可担心呢。”

en.t: Since worldly affairs change so unpredictably, I have much to fear about the future."
